selected_records.title: Bipartisan Senate bill would push DOD to expand its oversight of in-use commercial frontier AI models

article.body:
Bipartisan Senate bill would expand DOD oversight of commercial frontier AI

A bipartisan Senate bill would push DOD to expand oversight of in-use commercial frontier AI models, according to the assigned report’s headline. The available record provides no bill name, provisions, regulatory mechanism or timeline. It identifies no autonomous vehicle, driving system, operating domain, safety data or transport service.
